title: Preservation of the multiplication frame
statement: Let $x,a,b,c$ be finite Boolean words, and let $v,u:\{0,1,\ldots,12\}\to\mathbb{N}$. If $v$ satisfies the ready multiplication conditions for $x,a,b,c$ and $u(r)=v(r)$ for every $r\ne 0$, then $u$ also satisfies those conditions.
hypotheses_covered: $v,u$ assign natural numbers to registers $0$ through $12$
$u$ agrees with $v$ at every register other than $0$
replaced:
Let $x,a,b,c$ be finite bit strings, and let $v$ and $u$ assign natural numbers to each
of $13$ registers. If $v$ satisfies the multiplication-ready conditions for $x,a,b,c$,
and $u$ agrees with $v$ on every register other than register $0$, then $u$ also
satisfies those multiplication-ready conditions.
